_meta.note: Gemstone mutation RECIPES (G6 owner ruling 2026-07-23 round 3, char-sheet repo rulebook/skills-passover.md; book gpt-system-v0.92.md §4.5). A mutation merges compatible parent skills at the Skill Gemstone into a new skill: parents must be owned at >= min_level and pairwise share a NARROW keyword per the G3 rule (data/skill_keywords.json), BOTH parents are CONSUMED, and the result arrives at the recipe level. simulation/skill_forge.gd is the engine (validate_mutation / apply_mutation — pure, all-violations-at-once). COST: the compendium's Modification Center prices a Skill Gemstone use at 1 Bronze ('disassemble/consume/merge') — that is ECONOMY, deliberately unpriced in this engine; KAN-7 progression owns pricing. Recipes validate against skill KEYS + LEVELS only — SkillBook implementation is NOT required (CombatantState.from_spec accepts any {key, level} grant row), so a roster can own the result as data before its content pass.
_meta.schema: mutation: { key (unique recipe id), name (display), parents: [{key, min_level}] (>= 2 distinct skill keys), result: {key, level} (not a parent key), note (provenance + economy), compatibility_override? (bool — authored GM override for a recipe whose parents do NOT share a narrow keyword; the G3 broad-only GM-call tier made explicit. No shipped recipe needs it: Intercept x Brace share the narrow keyword 'bracing'), twin_of? (string — this recipe is the authored MIRROR of another recipe: same parent key set, mirrored min-levels, SAME result key. The one sanctioned result-key duplication; validate_seeds enforces the pairing) }
_meta.tiers: TIER-2 ENABLEMENT (decisions #34 + #35, owner 2026-08-18; docs/design/skill-tiers-proposal.md RULED): recipes M2-M8 below are the seven ruled tier-2 merges, plus M8's mirrored animal-side twin. Min-levels are PER-RECIPE authored values (Q5 — no global convention; the 5/3 pairs are each recipe's own numbers, changeable per recipe). Result skills are DATA-DECLARED ONLY for now — no data/skills.json rows yet; tier-2 rung content is the next content pass. The forge grants the result key at L1 and CombatantState.from_spec accepts unknown keys (the proven iron_stance interim pattern). Q3 OPENNESS: tier-3 merges WILL exist — nothing in this schema or validate_seeds restricts a parent key to tier-1 skills; a tier-2 result key (e.g. iron_stance) is a legal future recipe PARENT. All result NAMES are PROVISIONAL pending the owner's rename pass. Pricing stays KAN-7.

mutations.name: Iron Stance
mutations.note: THE first authored Gemstone mutation and the book §4.5 canonical example (G6 round 3, owner 2026-07-23): Intercept Lv 5 + Brace Lv 3 — compatible through 'bracing' — merge into Iron Stance; the mobile bodyguard consumes the self-brace and becomes the rooted bulwark. Both parents consumed; the mutation arrives at level 1. Effect (table canon, seeded template): stance — while you hold your ground, attacks on adjacent allies retarget to you, plus persistent Crush/Burn reduction. IMPLEMENTED (content pass batch B): the retarget-guard archetype landed in ActionResolver — Intercept and Iron Stance are both in SkillBook.KNOWN_KEYS, so this recipe's result is a real, usable stance (the R27 DATA-ONLY interim is retired).

mutations.name: Counterscript
mutations.note: M2 (decision #35, tier proposal §2 — name PROVISIONAL): the read that exists to be acted on fuses with the counter that acts on it, compatible through 'patterning'. You don't read the pattern and then counter — every declared action near you is already an opening you answer. Min-levels are this recipe's own authored values (Q5). Result is DATA-DECLARED ONLY — no skills.json row until the tier-2 content pass (threshold rows id 8 + 10 re-map into its rungs then).

mutations.name: Predator's Arc
mutations.note: M3 (decision #35, tier proposal §2 — name PROVISIONAL): the leap and the kill are one motion, compatible through 'blade' — the apex-predator takedown that still opens/loops through Slip Through (the tier-2 counts as Pounce for its chain gate — authored rung, ruling #4; content-pass scope). Min-levels per-recipe (Q5). Result DATA-DECLARED ONLY until the tier-2 content pass (rows id 36 + 40 re-map then).

mutations.name: Earthbreaker
mutations.note: M4 (decision #35, tier proposal §2 — name PROVISIONAL): the heavy chain's opener and finisher fuse into one gravity arc, compatible through 'blunt' + 'power' (the strongest pair in the power cluster); counts as Overhead Slam for Shockwave's chain gate (authored rung, ruling #4; content-pass scope). Min-levels per-recipe (Q5). Result DATA-DECLARED ONLY until the tier-2 content pass (rows id 42 ⚠ re-expressed per default #2 + 46 re-map then).

mutations.name: Vivisection
mutations.note: M5 (decision #35, tier proposal §2 — name PROVISIONAL): the complete shredder — many wounds on many parts, every wound worsening; the bleed-out clock made a skill. Compatible through 'blade' + 'flurry' (the only 2-narrow pair outside M4). Min-levels per-recipe (Q5). Result DATA-DECLARED ONLY until the tier-2 content pass (row id 80 re-maps then; thousand_cuts carries no rows — its past-5 content authors fresh).

mutations.name: Perfect Evasion
mutations.note: M6 (decision #35, tier proposal §2 — name PROVISIONAL): the whole evasion suite in one stance — dodge-move and forced-action save fused, compatible through 'tumbling'; both halves stay R25 movement-forfeit-gated. Min-levels per-recipe (Q5). Result DATA-DECLARED ONLY until the tier-2 content pass (rows id 16 + 68 re-map then).

mutations.name: Combat Medic
mutations.note: M7 (decision #35, tier proposal §2 — name PROVISIONAL): the arena medic — anyone, anywhere, conditions held; delay/arrest/stabilize only, never HP, never a full cure (ladder default #8). Compatible through 'treatment' (each parent's only legal partner). Min-levels per-recipe (Q5). Result DATA-DECLARED ONLY until the tier-2 content pass (rows id 6 + 88 re-map then).

mutations.name: Vice Grip
mutations.note: M8 (decision #35, tier proposal §2 — name PROVISIONAL): the perfected hold regardless of anatomy — hands, jaws, whatever you have; R9 size/boss Suffocation caps ride along uncut. Compatible through 'grapple' (each parent's only legal partner). Min-levels per-recipe (Q5). Result DATA-DECLARED ONLY until the tier-2 content pass (rows id 12 + 86 re-map then). The animal-side mirror is its own authored twin recipe: vice_grip_animal.

mutations.name: Vice Grip
mutations.note: M8's mirrored ANIMAL-SIDE twin (decision #35, tier proposal §2 note: 'a cheap authored twin if wanted' — authored per the ruling's 48-stamps-and-8-recipes adoption): for animal-body characters whose grapple identity IS the jaws, the primary/secondary roles flip — Jaws Lv 5 + Hold Lv 3 — yielding the SAME Vice Grip. Same result key by design (twin_of marks the sanctioned duplication); min-levels per-recipe (Q5); name PROVISIONAL with its twin.
